title: An Unsolvable Problem of Elementary Number Theory
author: Alonzo Church
description: Proof that the decision problem for first-order logic is unsolvable, using lambda calculus
rights: Public domain in the US. American Journal of Mathematics vol. 58, 1936. The Online Books Page reports no issue or contribution renewal for that serial, and the issue is pre-1950.
